0x000982.en: 「At my current skill level...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000A7B.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000BA4.en: 「Is this as far as I go......!?」

0x000CE0.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　Not funny...」

0x000D34.en: 「Screwed up...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000DA8.en: 「Gah! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000E85.en: 「This is as far as I go... The rest is up to you.」

0x000EB7.en: 「Damn it...!@　Is this where it ends?!」

0x000F31.en: 「No good, I took too much damage... I'm pulling back!」

0x000F7E.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000FBC.en: 「Kyaaah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001003.en: 「To think... the Granzon would be shot down...」

0x0010AE.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x001165.en: 「Owowow... I give up. My math was off.」

0x0011EA.en: 「U-ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001257.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00129E.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0012D3.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001390.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x0013BF.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　I'm still green...!」

0x00140D.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0014C8.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0014F7.en: 「Th-this is bad! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001535.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001564.en: 「I can't go any further. Please excuse me.」

0x0015EF.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll fall back for now...!」

0x00163D.en: 「T-to end up in a place like this...!」

0x00166C.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold out after all...!」

0x001755.en: 「Ejecting, I am...@　Ngh...! No style at all, it seems...」

0x0019E3.en: 「A-all hands!@　Make abandoning ship your first priority...!!」

0x001A25.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x001A57.en: 「I've no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001AA7.en: 「Everyone out there,@　welcome to the world of Super Robot Wars!@　I'm Arado Balanga!」

0x001B34.en: 「And serving as my coach is@ the demon instructor who can make even a crying baby laugh...」

0x001BD1.en: 「Never mind.@　I'm Major Kai Kitamura, commander of the Special Tactics Instructor Corps.」

0x001C30.en: 「Believe it or not, the Major's a lot younger than he looks.」

0x001C6D.en: 「Gah! What's that supposed to mean?!@　Keep your mouth shut!」

0x001CE2.en: 「...Ahem.@　Now then, let's begin the lecture on how to play.」

0x001D75.en: 「Arado, have you ever played@　Super Robot Wars before?」

0x001DE3.en: 「No sir, never!@　I'm a total rookie!」

0x001E2A.en: 「...You've read the manual thoroughly beforehand, I trust?」

0x001EA7.en: 「You fool!@　What do you take Super Robot Wars for?!」

0x001F3A.en: 「...Correct.@　Now then, I'll explain from the very beginning.」

0x001F8D.en: 「U-um, Major Kai...@　I'm not really that quick to catch on,@　so... will I be okay?」

0x002014.en: 「Then get this into your head first.@　Whenever there's something you don't understand,@　press the SELECT button.」

0x0020B3.en: 「The SELECT button, you mean@　the one on the wireless controller?」

0x002112.en: 「Yes.@　Depending on the situation, it'll explain the controls and functions.」

0x002162.en: 「When in doubt, SELECT button.@　Don't you forget it.」

0x0021C2.en: 「Now, step by step, I'll explain@　how to play Super Robot Wars.」

0x002224.en: 「A scene like this one, where we're@　talking right now, is called a@　'scenario demo'...」

0x00229C.en: 「You advance a 'scenario demo' by pressing the O button.」

0x0022EB.en: 「And if you press R1 and O@　at the same time, you can fast-forward.」

0x002359.en: 「Furthermore, press START and@　R1 together, and the 'scenario demo'@　gets skipped all at once.」

0x002411.en: 「Hold it. Try that here and this 'scenario demo'@　will come to an end.」

0x0024BA.en: 「Still, that last function's handy@　for a second playthrough and such,@　so I'll jot it down.」

0x00253B.en: 「A fine attitude, but@　do you actually remember it correctly?」

0x002588.en: 「Uh, uhh... um... well...@　how did it go again?」

0x0025DB.en: 「...Just as I thought. In that case, press the Triangle button.」

0x00261E.en: 「That brings up the 'backlog,'@　letting you scroll back and reread@　the conversation up to a point.」

0x0026B4.en: 「So even if I accidentally skip a line,@　I'll be fine!」

0x002713.en: 「But there's a limit to how much you can reread.@　Bear that in mind.」

0x00277F.en: 「Also,@　sometimes a differently-colored word@　shows up in the dialogue...」

0x0027EB.en: 「That's a 'keyword.' Press the Square button@　and you can open an explanation window.」

0x00286E.en: 「<The Inspector Incident>.@　...Press Square at a time like this and the explanation appears.」

0x0028E1.en: 「<The Inspector Incident>.@　Press the Square button and give it a try.」

0x002959.en: 「For the other controls during a 'scenario demo,'@　just press that SELECT button@　I mentioned earlier.」

0x0029EC.en: 「Do that, and@　a plate explaining the various controls will appear.」

0x002A67.en: 「I see...@　So pressing SELECT lets me@　view those control explanations again.」

0x002AE2.en: 「Now then, on to the battle map.」

0x002B16.en: 「Huh, so this is a battle map.」

0x002B44.en: 「In Super Robot Wars, you advance@　by clearing the battle maps prepared@　for each scenario.」

0x002BCB.en: 「First you move your robots,@　a.k.a. 'units,' during the Player Phase...」

0x002C36.en: 「Once that's done,@　the computer moves the enemy units.」

0x002C8C.en: 「So my turn and the enemy's turn alternate.@　Like shogi or baseball.」

0x002CF1.en: 「Correct.@　The game proceeds by repeating@　the Player Phase and Enemy Phase.」

0x002D6C.en: 「Got it.@　So what exactly am I supposed to do?」

0x002DC5.en: 「The objective for clearing a scenario...@　the 'mission objective,' is shown in the 'general command.'」

0x002E6A.en: 「Put the cursor on a unit and press O to bring up@　the 'unit command' for operating that unit...」

0x002EF9.en: 「Put the cursor where there's no unit and@　press O to display the 'general command.'」

0x002FCA.en: 「And putting the cursor on a unit@　and pressing O brings up the@　'unit command,' right.」

0x003054.en: 「All those commands... think I can memorize them all...?」

0x0030A0.en: 「No need to worry.@　You'll understand how each command works@　by actually using it during the game.」

0x00311E.en: 「That 'mission objective' from before is@　inside the 'general command,' right.@　Let's take a look.」

0x0031AB.en: 「That red robot@ is the Razangriff Raven.」

0x0031FB.en: 「So I operate that one@　and move it to the point.」

0x00324E.en: 「Correct.@　Get it to that designated point@　and the victory condition is met.」

0x0032B4.en: 「Now, use the 'move' unit command@　and head for the designated point.」

0x00331C.en: 「Note that the Mass-Prod Huckebein Mk-II over there@　can't act this time.」

0x003387.en: 「A unit can act only once per phase.」

0x0033C7.en: 「Once it ends its action,@　it can't move for that phase. Take note.」

0x00346D.en: 「Huh?@　Guess I came up a little short...」

0x0034A8.en: 「That's every unit that can move.@　They've all finished their turn.」

0x003517.en: 「You hand the phase to the enemy.@　Pick 'End Phase' at the top of the@　'Squad Command' list and confirm.」

0x0035AA.en: 「Do that, or the game won't advance.」

0x0035DE.en: 「What happens when I pass the phase, sir?」

0x00361E.en: 「Normally, the enemy units act.@　But there's no enemy here now, so@　it'll jump straight to your phase.」

0x0036DC.en: 「Right, this time I'll pull it off!」

0x0037E4.en: 「Not quite. Your target point is over there.」

0x003821.en: 「A bit far... @　Eh, I'll just split it into two moves.」

0x003874.en: 「Hold on.@　An 'SR Point Condition' has been added@　to the 'Mission Objectives.'」

0x0038E0.en: 「For real?@　Let me see that again, Major.」

0x00394D.en: 「An 'SR (Super Robot Wars) Point'...@　It's a challenge set for each map,@　separate from the victory conditions.」

0x0039DD.en: 「Clear it, and you earn an 'SR Point.'」

0x003A63.en: 「The moment you get one, every allied@　pilot on the map gains 10 'PP'...@　points used to train pilots.」

0x003B2D.en: 「But earning points marks you@　as a skilled player, and the@　game's difficulty goes up.」

0x003BB4.en: 「Get 80% or more of all the 'SR Points' -@　one per map - and difficulty goes to Hard.@　Under 80% keeps it Normal.」

0x003C74.en: 「So beginners don't have to push@　to collect 'SR Points.'」

0x003CD9.en: 「So it's basically a challenge thrown down@　to players who fancy their skills.」

0x003D94.en: 「But with that unit's movement, there's@　no way it'll reach the target point@　in a single move, sir.」

0x003E7A.en: 「Special commands set@　for each individual pilot.」

0x003EC7.en: 「They spend 'Spirit Points,' or 'SP,'@　to trigger all kinds of effects@　on a unit or pilot.」

0x003F75.en: 「Wh-whoa, like magic.@　Can I go wild with those right from the start?」

0x003FEC.en: 「Depends on the pilot.@　At low levels, though, they only have@　a limited set of 'Spirit Commands.'」

0x0040CE.en: 「They gradually learn new@　'Spirit Commands' to match, and@　their 'Spirit Points' rise too.」

0x004158.en: 「Then if I learn like a hundred@　'Spirit Commands,' I'm unstoppable!」

0x0041C6.en: 「Life's not that easy.@　One pilot can learn no more@　than six 'Spirit Commands.'」

0x004275.en: 「When a new pilot joins, it's worth@　checking what 'Spirit Commands'@　they bring with them.」

0x00430E.en: 「You can't clear the next LESSON 2@　without using a Spirit Command.」

0x00439E.en: 「All right!@　Time to take on LESSON 2!」

0x0043DF.en: 「First, pass the phase to the enemy.」

0x004438.en: 「Pick 'End Phase' at the top of the@　Squad Command list and press O.」

0x0044A6.en: 「Normally the enemy units act.@　But there's no enemy now, so@　it'll jump straight to your phase.」

0x004573.en: 「Now use 'End Phase' to@　end your phase.」

0x0045C6.en: 「Pick 'End Phase' from the Squad@　Command list and press O.」

0x004675.en: 「Hold it.@　You won't reach the target point@　without using a certain something.」

0x0046D4.en: 「A certain something?@　You mean a 'Spirit Command'?」

0x004721.en: 「Right. Use 'Accel,' the 'Spirit@　Command' that boosts a unit's movement.」

0x004798.en: 「Mind you, there are many kinds of@　'Spirit Command' besides 'Accel.'」

0x0047FD.en: 「'Valor' to deal big damage,@　'Focus' to dodge for certain...」

0x004880.en: 「'Guts' or 'Trust' when you want@　to restore a unit's HP...」

0x0048DF.en: 「Using the right 'Spirit Command' for@　the situation is key to winning.」

0x004944.en: 「Then let's just zip-zip-zip through it@　with 'Accel' and clear the thing!」

0x0049F6.en: 「Fail... and you get no more than two refills at dinner.」

0x004A3C.en: 「Gah!@　B-but I'll take my chances anyway!」

0x004A83.en: 「Your chances aren't worth much.@　You sure about this?」

0x004ADC.en: 「Actually... it'd be nice if I could redo it...」

0x004B60.en: 「Yeah. In the 'Squad Command' list@　there's a command called 'Mid-Battle Save.'」

0x004BC8.en: 「Use it and you can record@　the state mid-game.」

0x004C24.en: 「Then, during play, hold@　R1, R2, L1, L2, START and@　SELECT together to...」

0x004CAE.en: 「return to the state when you saved.」

0x004D1C.en: 「If you make an irreversible mistake,@　you can soft reset and start over.」

0x004EB0.en: 「Use the 'Accel' Spirit Command@　and you'd have reached the point.」

0x004F18.en: 「Fine, just this once -@ I'll let you have the 'SR Point.'」

0x004F7A.en: 「I see.@　So this is what grabbing an 'SR Point' does.」

0x004FD0.en: 「SR Point conditions vary from map to map.」

0x00501C.en: 「Some are easy, like this one, and@　some demand all sorts of skills@　and tactics to pull off.」

0x0050B5.en: 「Also, replaying from a Game Over@　locks out 'SR Points.' Keep that in mind.」

0x005138.en: 「Th-that sounds like a lot of work.」

0x005163.en: 「You can advance and clear the game@　without earning any 'SR Points.'」

0x0051D7.en: 「So beginners are best off playing@　without worrying about 'SR Points.'」

0x00524B.en: 「The difficulty stays lower that way, too.」

0x00528B.en: 「Got it!@　Then I'll play easy and not sweat it!」

0x005324.en: 「Combat is the single most important@　element in 'Super Robot Wars.'」

0x0053A8.en: 「Don't rush, Arado.@　You charging in alone won't win a battle.」

0x005407.en: 「Using your squads well is the key.」

0x005469.en: 「Squads you control on the map come@　in two kinds: 'Twin Units' and@　'Single Units.'」

0x0054F3.en: 「A 'Twin Unit' has two positions...@　a main unit that leads the squad and@　a sub unit that follows - two machines...」

0x0055A4.en: 「A 'Single Unit' is just@　the one main machine.」

0x005603.en: 「A 'Twin Unit' acts as a squad.@　Both machines move - and attack - as one.」

0x00568C.en: 「And only 'Twin Units' can use@　'Twin Spirit Commands.'」

0x005703.en: 「Only the main pilot can use them, and@　unlike normal 'Spirit Commands,' they@　spend both main pilots' 'Spirit Points.'」

0x0057DB.en: 「...Might be easier to grasp if I just show you.」

0x00582A.en: 「But there's no 'Twin Unit' on the map, sir.」

0x005873.en: 「You can rebuild a squad on the map@　into a 'Single Unit' or a 'Twin Unit.'」

0x005922.en: 「Use 'Merge' from the 'Individual@　Command' list to make a 'Twin Unit'@　from two adjacent 'Single Units.'」

0x0059EB.en: 「There's no 'Will' limit or such, but@　battleships can't form a 'Twin Unit.'」

0x005A6B.en: 「The window shown when merging displays@　the squad's 'Abilities' and their effects.」

0x005B04.en: 「'Abilities' are equipped to machines and pilots,@　granting special effects that turn a@　fight in your favor.」

0x005B99.en: 「You can equip three each to the@　'Slots' on a machine and a pilot.」

0x005C0A.en: 「And when three or more of the same@　'Ability' line up, its 'Ability Effect'@　activates.」

0x005C90.en: 「An 'Ability Effect' grants the squad@　various boosts - weapon damage,@　evasion, and the like.」

0x005D2F.en: 「A 'Single Unit' covers six 'Slots' -@　machine and main pilot - while a@　'Twin Unit' covers twelve in all.」

0x005DF2.en: 「So a 'Single Unit' gets up to@　two 'Ability Effects,' but...」

0x005E63.en: 「A 'Twin Unit' triggers up to four@　'Ability Effects' on each machine -@　so it's the better deal.」

0x005F02.en: 「And you equip 'Abilities' via the@　'Ability' command in the Intermission.」

0x005FC5.en: 「When a 'Twin Unit' attacks, the sub@　machine doesn't have to attack, but@　it can still be targeted by counters.」

0x006067.en: 「And as I said, a unit acts only once@　per phase, so the sub machine's@　turn ends as well.」

0x006106.en: 「It's done for the turn without doing@　anything... what a waste.」

0x006165.en: 「When that happens, just turn the@　'Twin Unit' into a 'Single Unit.'」

0x0061D0.en: 「To make a 'Twin Unit' into a@　'Single Unit,' use the 'Individual@　Command' 'Split.'」

0x00625A.en: 「But note - if you split, any active@　'Twin Spirit Command' effects@　are lost.」

0x0062E1.en: 「Now, let's bring out some enemy units.」

0x006315.en: 「Before the fight, a word on weapons.」

0x0063A8.en: 「Uhh... 'All' means a weapon with@　the 'ALL' mark, and...」

0x006422.en: 「'Map' means one with the 'MAP' mark,@　and one with nothing is@　'Normal,' right?」

0x0064BB.en: 「Right. An attack using a 'Normal'@　weapon is a 'Normal Attack'...」

0x006526.en: 「An attack with an 'All' weapon is an@　'All Attack,' and one with a 'Map'@　weapon is a 'Map Weapon.'」

0x0065D1.en: 「A 'Normal Attack' weapon damages one@　machine, while an 'All Attack'@　weapon damages a whole squad...」

0x006669.en: 「A 'Map Weapon' damages every squad@　within its attack range.」

0x0066F6.en: 「Note, too, that combat has position@　matchups you need to watch.」

0x006755.en: 「Same position is fine - main hitting@　the enemy's main, or sub hitting sub -@　but...」

0x006806.en: 「Opposite positions - main hitting a@　sub machine, say - deal less@　damage than usual.」

0x0068AB.en: 「A main machine's attack deals 100%@　damage to the enemy's main and@　65% to the sub.」

0x006954.en: 「Also, some weapons can't be used@　unless the pilot's 'Will' is@　at or above a set value.」

0x0069DB.en: 「'Will' affects the damage you deal, too.@　Joining a fight, or having an enemy or@　ally shot down, raises or lowers it.」

0x006A98.en: 「Now, let me show you an 'All Attack' for real.」

0x006B06.en: 「Some 'All Attack' weapons can perform@　a 'Double Attack,' hitting an adjacent@　enemy squad at the same time.」

0x006BF2.en: 「As I said, a 'Map Weapon' damages@　every squad within its attack range.」

0x006C72.en: 「And position doesn't reduce the@　damage, nor do you take a counter.」

0x006D05.en: 「But if allies are in range, they'll@　take damage right alongside the enemy.」

0x006D79.en: 「When using a 'Map Weapon,' be very careful.」

0x006DD2.en: 「Now, let's use a 'Map Weapon' for real.」

0x006E43.en: 「A trait of 'Map Weapons' is that each@　type has its own range pattern.」

0x006EFD.en: 「Huh? A 'Normal Attack' isn't just one thing?」

0x006F49.en: 「Right. In combat between 'Twin Units,'@　you can pick 'Individual Attack' or@　'Focus Attack.' Let me explain each.」

0x007000.en: 「First, 'Individual Attack.'@　The 'Twin Unit's' two machines hit@　the enemy in the same position.」

0x00709C.en: 「Use 'Individual Attack' when you want@　to spread damage evenly over a squad.」

0x007154.en: 「Where 'Individual Attack' hits the enemy@　in the same position, 'Focus Attack'@　lets you name one machine and hit it.」

0x007217.en: 「So I can gang up on whoever's in the way.」

0x007257.en: 「Exactly.@　Now, let me show you a 'Focus Attack.'」

0x0072B6.en: 「That was a 'Focus Attack.' Remember@　that 'Normal Attacks' come in@　'Individual' and 'Focus' kinds.」

0x00734F.en: 「Note, too, that 'Normal Attacks' can@　trigger 'Support Attack' or 'Support@　Defense' from an adjacent squad.」

0x0073DB.en: 「With 'Support Attack,' an adjacent squad@　follows your 'Normal Attack' with an@　extra strike.」

0x00745B.en: 「'Support Defense' is the reverse - when@　you take an enemy 'Normal Attack,' an@　adjacent squad takes the damage for you.」

0x0074F7.en: 「I see... so with a 'Normal Attack,'@　the guy next door might lend a hand.」

0x007565.en: 「True, but you can't use 'Support@　Attack' just any time.」

0x0075CA.en: 「To use 'Support Attack' or 'Support@　Defense,' the main pilot needs the@　'Support Attack Lv' or 'Support Defense Lv' skill.」

0x007693.en: 「Understood!@　I'll pick that up as I play!」

0x0076E3.en: 「Beyond the attacks I've covered, there@　are also 'Combination Attacks' and@　'Maximum Breaks,' among others.」

0x007785.en: 「A 'Combination Attack' uses a weapon@　made for it and hits up to@　five enemies at once.」

0x00782A.en: 「Weapons marked with a 'C' are the ones@　you can use for a 'Combination Attack.'」

0x0078AA.en: 「Also, attack targets must be adjacent to each other, and@ the attacking pilot must know the skill 'Continuous Attack Lv.'」

0x00796D.en: 「If two Twin Units are adjacent and the attacking@　pilot has learned the special skill 'Command,'@　you can perform a 'Maximum Break.'」

0x007A48.en: 「In a 'Maximum Break,' all four units@　make a simultaneous strike with 'F'-marked support@　weapons, then attack with the main weapon.」

0x007AF3.en: 「Note that weapons with the 'ALL' mark@　can't be used as the main weapon.」

0x007B61.en: 「And everyone's 'Will' must be 140 or higher.@　Also, Will drops by 10 after the attack.@　Think carefully about when to use it.」

0x007C27.en: 「The key to victory is using the attacks I've taught you@　as the situation demands.」

0x007C95.en: 「'Normal Attack,' 'All Attack,'@　and, uh... what was that other one?」

0x007CF7.en: 「I already taught you what to do at times like this.」

0x007D65.en: 「Come on... it was the very first thing I taught you.」

0x007D9F.en: 「Oh, right!@　You press the SELECT button!」

0x007DE6.en: 「Next, I'll teach you how to bring up the Menu Help@　for term explanations on the status screens.」

0x007E5A.en: 「Using 'Ability' from the 'Individual Commands'@　lets you view a unit's various stats.」

0x007EDA.en: 「Arado, try bringing up the help for the@　weapon types I mentioned earlier.」

0x007F39.en: 「Let's see, open 'Ability' from 'Individual Commands'...@　then press SELECT on the 'Weapon Stats' screen.」

0x007FC5.en: 「I see... the help tells you all kinds of things.」

0x00800B.en: 「Note that SELECT Help is also available@　while the 'General Commands' or@　'Individual Commands' are displayed.」

0x0080A1.en: 「In that case, a command description appears@　at the bottom of the screen.」

0x008127.en: 「Landing a hit on an enemy or shooting one down@　earns you 'Experience.'」

0x008180.en: 「Every 500 'Experience' points, a pilot levels up@　and grows stronger.」

0x0081E8.en: 「You can also gain 'Experience' by using the@　'Repair' and 'Resupply' commands.」

0x00828A.en: 「Special commands that support@　a unit in battle.」

0x0082E0.en: 「Only certain units can use them, but...@　without mastering them, you won't win@　the tough battles.」

0x008385.en: 「And if you make a unit with that ability@　a squad leader, the command shows up@　under 'Individual Commands.'」

0x008415.en: 「For example, after taking damage from an enemy attack...」

0x00846E.en: 「I'll switch the main to the mass-produced@　Huckebein Mk-II with the repair unit equipped.」

0x00854E.en: 「'Resupply' restores a unit's spent EN@　and weapon ammo.」

0x0085C2.en: 「Both commands only work on squads within@　'Repair' or 'Resupply' range, so be careful.」

0x008651.en: 「Also, shooting down an enemy earns 'Funds' and 'PP,'@　and sometimes even 'Upgrade Parts.'」

0x0086E0.en: 「You'll use those during the 'Intermission'@　after clearing a map.」

0x008751.en: 「All right!@　First, beat the enemy and clear the map!」

0x008798.en: 「The enemy fights back too, so watch yourself.」

0x0087CF.en: 「Now then, let's begin the final LESSON.」

0x008803.en: 「Clear this, and you'll be ready@　to start the game right away.」

0x0088C1.en: 「I won this time, but I bet there are some@　real tough maps out there.@　Think I'll be able to clear 'em?」

0x008976.en: 「Normally, this is where you'd get a Game Over.」

0x0089E1.en: 「No need to worry.@　When you get a Game Over, you restart@　from the beginning of that map, but...」

0x008A65.en: 「The 'Funds' and 'Experience' you earned@　before the Game Over carry over.」

0x008AD6.en: 「So if I get a Game Over after leveling up,@　I can retry starting from@　that level?」

0x008B78.en: 「That's right.@　Even a tough map can be cleared with enough tries.」

0x008BF6.en: 「There's also a 'Strategy Q&A' that gathers tips@　and info useful for beating the game.」

0x008C67.en: 「Reading it will help you out when you're@　tackling a difficult map.」

0x008D00.en: 「Select 'LIBRARY' on the title screen,@　then choose 'Strategy Q&A'...」

0x008D80.en: 「Or, in the 'Intermission,' go to 'Library'@　under 'Options' and proceed to@　the 'Strategy Q&A.'」

0x008E10.en: 「Well then, that concludes the battle map guidance.」

0x008E7E.en: 「That was a piece of cake!@　So, is this the 'Intermission'?」

0x008EEC.en: 「No, it isn't. Once this 'Scenario Demo' ends,@　the 'Intermission' begins.」

0x008F63.en: 「That's where you prep to move on to the next scenario.」

0x008FBC.en: 「For instance, saving the game data@　up to this point...」

0x009012.en: 「Reorganizing your squads for the next scenario,@　equipping 'Upgrade Parts' to your units...」

0x009092.en: 「Upgrading units with 'Funds' earned on the map,@　or training pilots with 'PP.'」

0x009134.en: 「To really understand its role, it's best to see@　the 'Intermission' in the main game itself.@　And try out the various actions yourself.」

0x0091EB.en: 「Got it.@　Then I'll go play the main game right away!」

0x00923E.en: 「Before that, a quick review.@　What do you do when there's something you don't know?」

0x0092E6.en: 「First off, I'll somehow call up Major Kai!」

0x009332.en: 「Right, then I appear on screen and give you the answer...」

0x0093BE.en: 「Aw, man...@　But you players know the answer, right?」

0x00941D.en: 「Now then, that concludes the 'Guidance Scenario.'@　I wish all you players luck. See you in the main game.」
